Connectivity.Title: Connectivity probe
Connectivity.Subtitle: Probe a host, port, or HTTP endpoint from the application host.
Connectivity.PortPlaceholder: Leave empty to use protocol default
Connectivity.HintPing: Use Ping mode for a quick ICMP reachability check before moving on to port or application-level diagnostics.
Connectivity.HintTcp: Use TCP mode to verify whether the target port is reachable through routing and firewall rules.
Connectivity.HintHttp: Use HTTP or HTTPS mode when you also want to confirm that an application responds after the transport handshake succeeds.
Connectivity.NoResultSubtitle: Provide a target host and start a probe to inspect reachability, latency, and HTTP response details.

Summary.PingSucceeded: Ping to {0} replied from {1} in {2} ms.
Summary.TcpSucceeded: TCP connection to {0} succeeded in {1} ms.
Summary.HttpSucceeded: HTTP probe to {0} returned {1} in {2} ms.

Connectivity.TimeoutHelper: Timeout applies to individual probe operations; total duration can be longer.
Connectivity.CertificateBypassHelper: When selected, this probe bypasses server-certificate validation.
Connectivity.CertificateBypassWarning: Certificate validation will be bypassed for this request.
Connectivity.NoCompletedResult: No completed result for this attempt
Connectivity.NoCompletedResultHelper: Correct the request and run the probe again.
Connectivity.TransportFailed: Network probe did not complete successfully
Connectivity.HttpErrorResponseNote: The endpoint responded with HTTP {0}; receiving this response is successful contact, not a transport failure.

TextJson.Title: Text & JSON
TextJson.Subtitle: Decode escaped text, format JSON, or produce compact JSON with readable Unicode.
TextJson.InputPlaceholder: Paste escaped text or JSON here
TextJson.Hint: Format and minify keep Unicode readable instead of converting characters such as Chinese back into \uXXXX sequences.

Summary.DecodeUnchanged: No JSON-style escape sequences were decoded. Output was left unchanged.
Summary.Formatted: Formatted JSON with readable Unicode output.
Summary.FormattedWithLayers: Formatted JSON with readable Unicode output after removing {0} JSON string layer(s).
Summary.Minified: Minified JSON with readable Unicode output.
Summary.MinifiedWithLayers: Minified JSON with readable Unicode output after removing {0} JSON string layer(s).

TextJson.AttemptDraftChanged: This error belongs to the last attempted input, which differs from the current draft.
TextJson.FailedOutputRetained: The failed attempt did not replace this output.
TextJson.LengthUnits: Lengths are UTF-16 code units. Format and minify trim input before processing.

Messages.OutputReused: Output moved back into the input editor.
